property_summary: For any caller address, the correct contract C allows the current owner (the address stored in owner) to successfully call setOwner and update owner; the mutant restricts onlyOwner to accept address(0) so some callers (including the current owner) will be unable to call setOwner and the call will revert or not change owner.
change_summary: Tightened the require so only a hardcoded different address (zero address) is allowed, preventing original owner from calling setOwner and thus changing observable behavior.
